title: DFT SCF calculation
action: Run a DFT self-consistent field (SCF) calculation on rutile RuO2 using GGA-RPBE functional and norm-conserving pseudopotentials to obtain the ground-state charge density and Kohn-Sham wavefunctions. Use the provided crystal structure parameters (a=4.5149 Å, c=3.1156 Å, u=0.3057, space group P4_2/mnm).
description: Log of the SCF convergence and electronic structure output.

title: Compute elastic constants
action: Using the equilibrium SCF setup from step_01_scf, apply small finite strains (e.g., ±0.01) to the crystal and compute the resulting stress tensor. From the stress-strain relationship for tetragonal symmetry, determine the six independent elastic constants: c11, c33, c44, c66, c12, c13 (in GPa). Compute the bulk modulus B0 using the Voigt approximation: B0 = (2(c11+c12)+c33+4c13)/9. Record the computed values in a log file for later extraction.
description: Elastic constants and bulk modulus for comparison with paper Table 1.

title: Compute dielectric function ε(ω)
action: Using the wavefunctions and band energies from the SCF step, compute the imaginary part ε2(ω) from momentum matrix elements for polarizations E⊥c and E//c over 0–30 eV. Apply the Kramers–Kronig transformation to obtain the real part ε1(ω). Save the full ε1, ε2 data.
description: Raw dielectric function data (ε1, ε2) for both polarizations.

title: Extract optical and elastic summary
action: From the dielectric function, compute the static refractive indices n(0) for both polarizations using n(0) = sqrt(ε1(0)). Locate the main (highest) peak in ε2 for each polarization: record its energy position (eV) and magnitude. From the elastic constants computation (step_02_elastic), extract the elastic constants c11, c33, c44, c66, c12, c13 and the bulk modulus B0 (all in GPa). Write all these values to optical_summary.json.
description: Static refractive indices, ε2 peak parameters, and elastic constants for E⊥c and E//c.
output_schema: {"n_perp": float, "n_par": float, "epsilon2_peak_perp_position_eV": float, "epsilon2_peak_perp_magnitude": float, "epsilon2_peak_par_position_eV": float, "epsilon2_peak_par_magnitude": float, "c11_GPa": float, "c33_GPa": float, "c44_GPa": float, "c66_GPa": float, "c12_GPa": float, "c13_GPa": float, "B0_GPa": float}

title: Compute reflectivity spectrum
action: Using the dielectric function, compute the reflectivity R(ω) = |(1 - N(ω))/(1 + N(ω))|^2 with N^2 = ε1 + i ε2 for both polarizations and output the full spectrum from 0 to 30 eV as a CSV with columns energy_eV, R_perp, R_par.
description: Full reflectivity spectrum for both polarizations.
